Let me look at the submission files and examples.

Note the audit's work computation: `work += repeat*(n["pages"]*(hit if cached else miss) + (ceil(k/lanes)+decode[mode])*visits[off])`. Hmm, that's different from PROTOCOL's formula. PROTOCOL says:

Q = sum over bursts of repeat * number of addresses whose run is in [i,j)
T = sum over bursts of repeat * indicator(at least one such address)
contribution = P*(hit/miss)*T + (ceil(K/lanes)+decode[mode])*Q

But the audit computes per burst, per node: for each burst, for each node touched by the burst: repeat*(pages*(hit or miss) + (ceil(k/lanes)+decode)*visits[off]).

Wait — visits[off] counts visits within one burst (per address, counting duplicates as multiple comparisons). So per burst: repeat*(pages*cost + (ceil+decode)*visits) = pages*cost*repeat + (ceil+decode)*repeat*visits.

In the PROTOCOL formula: T = sum over bursts for v of repeat * indicator(at least one address in [i,j)). For a node touched by burst b, indicator >= 1, so T includes repeat. Q = sum over bursts of repeat*count(addresses whose run in [i,j)) = repeat * visits summed... but careful: visits[off] counts visits of that node by addresses in that burst. An address whose run is in [i,j) visits the node exactly once (since a tree path visits each node once). So visits[off] for a burst = number of addresses (with multiplicity) whose run is in [i,j). So Q = repeat * visits summed over bursts. Yes they match, except that audit only counts nodes touched (visits>0), matching T indicator. Good. So the audit formula is consistent with PROTOCOL for touched nodes; nodes never visited contribute 0 (both). Good.

Note: the audit only counts work for nodes that appear in a lookup path of some burst — nodes not visited contribute 0 work. But PROTOCOL says sum over ALL nodes of ALL version images. For unvisited nodes, Q=T=0, so contribution 0. Consistent.
